title: Categorical pasting of coefficient orientations
statement: Let F:C→D, F′:C′→D′, S:D→D′, T:C→C′, with q:F⋙S≅T⋙F′. Supply isomorphisms u:F M≅W, u′:F′ M′≅W′, a:M≅L, a′:M′≅L′, v:W≅F L and t:T L≅L′, an invertible c:T M→M′ and r:S W→W′. If u v=F(a), c a′=T(a)t and S(u)r=q_M F′(c)u′, then r is invertible and r u′⁻¹ F′(a′)=S(v)q_L F′(t).

proof.text: Cancel the invertible S(u) to express r as a composite of isomorphisms. Precompose the asserted orientation equation by S(u), substitute the two commuting squares, cancel u′ with its inverse, and use naturality of q. A private helper proves compatibility of an adjunction unit with the right mate by unit naturality and the triangle identity.

proof_origin.place: Proof (1)-(2); explicit Lean construction and square pasting

lean.statement:
theorem assembleOrientation
    {C D C' D' : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Category C'] [Category D']
    (F : C ⥤ D) (F' : C' ⥤ D') (S : D ⥤ D') (T : C ⥤ C')
    (q : F ⋙ S ≅ T ⋙ F') {M L : C} {M' L' : C'} {W : D} {W' : D'}
    (u : F.obj M ≅ W) (u' : F'.obj M' ≅ W') (a : M ≅ L) (a' : M' ≅ L')
    (v : W ≅ F.obj L) (t : T.obj L ≅ L')
    (c : T.obj M ⟶ M') [IsIso c] (r : S.obj W ⟶ W')
    (hv : u.hom ≫ v.hom = F.map a.hom)
    (hc : c ≫ a'.hom = T.map a.hom ≫ t.hom)
    (hr : S.map u.hom ≫ r = q.hom.app M ≫ F'.map c ≫ u'.hom) :
    IsIso r ∧ r ≫ u'.inv ≫ F'.map a'.hom =
      S.map v.hom ≫ q.hom.app L ≫ F'.map t.hom
